observation_method_correction.what_changed: Two official help nodes read on this date narrow what a landing URL can be said to show. Amazon states that a tracking ID 'is not necessary … to appear in order for us to track sales made after the initial click through', because the session is tagged on Amazon's side (S41). So the absence of a tag= parameter on an observed URL is a null observation, not evidence that a link failed to attribute, and no row on this record may be read that way in either direction.
observation_method_correction.what_still_cannot_be_seen: The positive: whether the selected ID is listed on the account, and whether a click through a published link appears under it. That is read in the Tracking ID Summary Report named by S42, and it requires the account holder's login. Until it is, the correct statement is the one this file already makes — the tag is recorded, not validated, and not applied to links.
observation_method_correction.where_it_applies: The inference is corrected where it is drawn in the present tense: the link-intent page carries this note next to the per-row test fields, and flag F81 records it. Historical rows, including the F76 observation and the dated flag prose about no tag appearing, are left exactly as written — they are records of what those passes observed, and rewriting them would remove the audit trail that makes them evidence.

sub_tag_plan.what: S42 records that additional tracking IDs are created at Associates Central > Manage your Tracking ID, that each one is reported in the Tracking ID Summary Report, and that an account may hold up to 100. One ID per channel — site, newsletter, social — separates traffic sources inside Amazon's own reporting, with no script on this site, nothing new to host and no new technology to disclose.
sub_tag_plan.limit: It attributes a channel, not a page: clicks and orders arrive per tracking ID, not per URL. Page-level questions stay with the five event definitions on measurement.html, which remain disabled until the endpoint contract there is satisfied.
sub_tag_plan.status: proposed; needs the account holder to create the IDs in Associates Central
